column3: “Vessel” is not expressed separately from the sheet.
BSB’s “I was” matches the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “we were” (ἦμεν).
“The work of” is supplied before God.
“Their objections were put to rest” replaces they were silent.
“With all their hearts” renders with purpose of heart.
“Him” supplies the absent object of finding and bringing.
“Their gifts” supplies the object; the hand is not expressed.
